long_biography.plain_text:
Nikolas Tsakos combines the chief executive's office at Tsakos Energy Navigation with three years of practical seafaring experience. He also served as a Hellenic Navy officer, studied economics and political science at Columbia, and completed postgraduate work in shipping, trade and finance in London.

At TEN, the founder-chief executive has combined commercial leadership with maritime governance. The listed company delegates executive and back-office functions to Tsakos Energy Management, which Tsakos solely owns, while technical operations pass to the family group's shipping manager. Beyond the company, he chaired INTERTANKO and has held board roles across Greek and international maritime bodies.
